title: Hesperetin Inhibits Abeta Early Aggregation by Disrupting the Continuity of the beta-Sheet Structure.
authors: Zhang, Yu; Wu, Yelong; Zhang, Shengli; Zhang, Lei; Li, Xuhua
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过REMD模拟研究橙皮素抑制Aβ早期聚集并破坏β-折叠连续性的原子机制，属于蛋白质构象采样与聚集抑制的结构计算研究，与课题高度相关。
abstract: The misfolding and pathological aggregation of amyloid-beta (Abeta) into insoluble amyloid deposits are closely associated with Alzheimer's disease (AD). Inhibiting early Abeta assembly is a critical strategy for the development of antiamyloid therapeutics. Hesperetin (HST), a natural flavanone abundant in citrus fruits, has been reported to inhibit Abeta fibrillogenesis and reduce Abeta-associated cytotoxicity. However, the molecular mechanism underlying HST-mediated inhibition of Abeta aggregation remains unclear. In particular, whether HST acts through mechanisms similar to other natural compounds or employs a distinct inhibitory strategy is yet to be determined. Here, we employed replica exchange molecular dynamics (REMD) simulations to investigate how HST modulates Abeta early aggregation and beta-sheet assembly at the atomic level. The results demonstrate that HST disrupts the continuity of beta-sheet structures within Abeta dimers, as evidenced by restricted beta-strand extension. Mechanistically, HST preferentially interacts with aggregation-prone regions of Abeta through a synergistic interaction network of hydrogen-bonding, hydrophobic, pi-pi stacking, and cation-pi interactions. Notably, HST-mediated hydrogen bonding with the Abeta backbone perturbs the local hydrogen-bonding environment required for beta-sheet extension, while cooperative nonpolar and aromatic interactions further stabilize HST-bound conformations and weaken intra- and intermolecular interaction networks involved in Abeta self-assembly. Collectively, these findings reveal a specific mechanism by which HST regulates Abeta aggregation through disruption of beta-sheet continuity, which provides atomic-level insights into the antiamyloid activity of natural flavanones.
abstract_zh: 淀粉样蛋白-β（amyloid-beta, Abeta）的错误折叠和病理性聚集形成不溶性淀粉样沉积，与阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）密切相关。抑制Abeta早期组装是开发抗淀粉样蛋白疗法的关键策略。橙皮素（Hesperetin, HST），一种富含于柑橘类水果中的天然黄烷酮，已被报道可抑制Abeta纤维形成并降低Abeta相关的细胞毒性。然而，HST介导的Abeta聚集抑制的分子机制仍不清楚。特别是，HST是否通过与其他天然化合物相似的机制发挥作用，或采用独特的抑制策略，尚待确定。在此，我们采用副本交换分子动力学（replica exchange molecular dynamics, REMD）模拟，在原子水平上研究HST如何调节Abeta早期聚集和β-折叠组装。结果表明，HST破坏了Abeta二聚体内β-折叠结构的连续性，表现为β-链延伸受限。机制上，HST通过氢键、疏水、π-π堆积和阳离子-π相互作用的协同交互网络，优先与Abeta的聚集倾向区域结合。值得注意的是，HST介导的与Abeta主链的氢键作用扰乱了β-折叠延伸所需的局部氢键环境，而协同的非极性和芳香族相互作用进一步稳定了HST结合构象，并削弱了参与Abeta自组装的分子内和分子间交互网络。综合来看，这些发现揭示了HST通过破坏β-折叠连续性来调节Abeta聚集的特异性机制，为天然黄烷酮的抗淀粉样蛋白活性提供了原子级见解。
